name: context-checker
description: Watch the context window and survive compaction. A status line renders live context usage, a UserPromptSubmit hook warns Claude once when usage crosses 60% and 75%, a PreCompact hook writes a markdown checkpoint of recent user messages, files touched, and commands run, and a PostCompact hook points Claude back at that checkpoint so anything the summary dropped can be recovered. Ships the context-checkpoint skill for preparing a deliberate /compact instead of letting auto-compact decide what to lose. Python 3 stdlib only, no dependencies.
